behavior_ja: 入口のx3は保持・retainされ、receiverはx21、keyはx19へ保存される。Cの引数表示だけではABIを復元できない。
behavior_en: Incoming x3 is saved/retained as x20; incoming receiver x0 is saved as x21; key x2 is retained as x19. The Ghidra C signature omits x3, so assembly and ObjC metadata control ABI interpretation.

behavior_ja: keyboardIndex比較はw0のbit0、outputChannel比較はw0全体の非0を使い、整数枝を選ぶ。
behavior_en: Key isEqualToString:keyboardIndex tests bit0 of w0; set bit enters integer path. Otherwise isEqualToString:outputChannel tests w0 nonzero; nonzero enters the same integer path.

behavior_ja: 整数枝は保存receiverへkeyを渡してdecodeIntegerForKey:を送り、返値ワードを保存する。
behavior_en: Integer path sends decodeIntegerForKey: to incoming receiver x21 using key x19, saves signed64 result x0 in x22 and joins common return cleanup.

behavior_ja: その他のキーはNSNumberに対するobjc_opt_classの返値をclass引数へ渡し、保存receiverへobject decoderを送る。
behavior_en: Other-key path loads imported NSNumber, calls objc_opt_class, passes its returned class x0 as x2 to decodeObjectOfClass:forKey: on receiver x21 with key x19 in x3.

behavior_ja: objectをretainし、追加のnil・型・error判定なしでlongValueを送り、返値を保存してobjectをreleaseする。
behavior_en: Object result is retained using objc_retainAutoreleasedReturnValue, sent longValue without a caller-side nil/type/result branch, x0 saved to x22, object then released. Native coder semantics and runtime selector dispatch remain unexamined.

behavior_ja: 通常終了で追加のincoming x3とkeyをreleaseし、保存した64 bitワードを返す。incoming x3は本文でretain/release以外に使わない。
behavior_en: Normal cleanup releases retained incoming x3 and key, returns saved result x22 in x0. Incoming x3 has no use other than retain/release in the complete saved 208 B body. It is not the object-path key x3, which is overwritten from x19.

behavior_ja: setterはruntime offset slotを読み、w2の下位byteを直接格納する。mask・正規化・別callなし。
behavior_en: Setter reads signed runtime ivar offset slot001ab508 and directly stores low byte of w2. No mask/normalization/extra call in this 16 B body.

behavior_ja: 旧long getterはruntime offset slotを読み、64 bit fieldを直接返す。変換・格納・別callなし。
behavior_en: Long getter reads signed runtime offset slot001ab4dc and loads the 64-bit field into x0; no conversion/store/call in this 16 B body.

behavior_ja: 旧形式flag getterはbyteを読み、bit0だけ返す。fieldの更新なし。
behavior_en: Flag getter reads signed runtime offset slot001ab4d8, loads one byte, masks bit0 into w0 and returns; no field update in this 20 B body.

behavior_ja: helper本文にcontains判定・native error検査・retry・longからdoubleへの変換はない。native失敗・例外動作は未確認。
behavior_en: Complete saved helper body has no containsValueForKey: send, native error argument/inspection, retry or scalar long-to-double conversion. Missing key/wrong type/nil/unarchiver failure and exception-unwind behavior are not established by these normal-path instructions.
